name: RawTherapee CLI
role: Headless RAW development with .pp3 profiles; camera RAW to TIFF or PNG for the pipeline
summary: RawTherapee's rawtherapee-cli develops camera RAW files non-interactively, applying a .pp3 processing profile (demosaic, white balance, exposure, tone, noise) and writing TIFF, PNG or JPEG. Output is deterministic for a given profile and version. Strength: high-quality demosaic and profile-driven batch development; it does nothing for non-RAW inputs.
use_when: Developing camera RAW stills into linear or sRGB TIFF as a production source
Batch-applying one .pp3 look to a folder of RAW files
Over ImageMagick, whose RAW support delegates to a separate decoder
avoid_when: Scene-referred EXR or ACES output: process RAW elsewhere, then oiiotool with OCIO
Interactive grading of single shots: use the GUI
Simple RAW preview thumbnails: libvips or exiftool previews
notes: 2026-10-26: Upstream site shows 5.13 (2026-07-26) with a macOS universal zip; it does not document the CLI, and rawtherapee.com/documentation returned 404. The path of rawtherapee-cli inside the macOS app bundle was not verified, so the check_command may not be on PATH.

assessment.rationale: Version 5.13 released 2026-07-26 per rawtherapee.com; Homebrew cask matches. Only RAW developer in the catalogue; CLI docs were not reachable so the automation route rests on general knowledge.
